title: Team
descriptionTeam: Invite teammates to manage contacts, templates, and campaign drafts together.
descriptionPersonal: Creating your first invitation converts this personal workspace into a team workspace.

restricted.title: Team collaboration requires the Team plan
restricted.description: Upgrade to the Team plan to invite members, assign roles, and view the full activity log.

memberCapNote: Active members exceed your plan seats. Existing members remain, but Operator write access is paused. An Admin can remove extra members or upgrade the plan to restore access.

hint.admin: Invitation links stay valid for 7 days; Admins can regenerate or revoke them anytime.
hint.readOnly: You can view team members and their current roles.

descriptions.admin: Admin: workspace settings, delivery channels, tracking & webhooks, team & billing, formal sends, and activity logs (by plan).
descriptions.editor: Operator: manage contacts and templates, draft/preview/confirm campaigns, export CSV; cannot edit settings/channels, send campaigns, or view logs.
descriptions.viewer: Viewer: read-only access to contacts, templates, campaigns, and delivery stats; cannot edit data/settings, send campaigns, or view logs.

invitations.securityHint: For security, only masked emails are shown. Links cannot be viewed again after closing — regenerate if needed.

inviteDialog.copyDescription: This link won't be shown again after closing. Regenerate from Pending invitations if needed.
inviteDialog.createDescription: Generate an invite link and assign a workspace role.
inviteDialog.expiryHint: Links expire in 7 days and are shown only once. Share securely via chat or company email.

confirm.removeDescription: Remove {name} from this workspace? They will lose access, while historical records remain.
confirm.transferDetail: {name} will become the workspace Owner responsible for billing and plans. You will remain an Admin without Owner-only permissions.
confirm.roleStep1AdminWarning: Downgrading an Admin removes access to team, billing, and formal sending. A second confirmation is required.
confirm.roleStep2Description: Final confirmation: change {name} from Admin to {toRole}. They will lose team and billing permissions.
confirm.revokeDescription: Revoke this invitation? The previous link will stop working immediately.

toast.invitationCreated: Invitation created — link is shown once
